t: Forge Steel 10-piece metric tap and die set is an essential tool for trade professionals needing to repair screw threads. Crafted from high carbon steel, the set offers robust durability and rust resistance, ensuring a long operational life in demanding workshop environments. Ideal for vehicle maintenance, engineering projects, and general machinery repair tasks. The comprehensive set contains 8 metric taps and dies in common sizes from M4 to M8, a "T" handle tap wrench and a die handle. The reliable toolkit supports accurate thread restoration. Not suitable for cutting new threads.
b: M4, M5, M6 & M8 Tap & Die Sizes
